atoms.a: Manchmal kann man am Himmel einen Regenbogen sehen.
atoms.b: Sometimes you can see a rainbow in the sky.
atoms.sound: Sometimes you can see a rainbow in the sky.

atoms.a: Für einen Regenbogen braucht man Sonne und Regen.
atoms.b: For a rainbow you need sun and rain.
atoms.sound: For a rainbow you need sun and rain.

atoms.a: Die Farben des Regenbogens sind: rot, orange, gelb, grün, hellblau, dunkelblau und lila.
atoms.b: The colours of the rainbow are: red, orange, yellow, green, light blue, dark blue and purple.
atoms.sound: The colours of the rainbow are: red, orange, yellow, green, light blue, dark blue and purple.

atoms.text: Sometimes you can see a rainbow in the sky. For a rainbow you need sun and rain. The colours of the rainbow are: red, orange, yellow, green, light blue, dark blue and purple.
